name: AniList
tagline: GraphQL API for anime and manga data, user lists, and social features
description: AniList provides a public GraphQL API for anime and manga metadata, user lists, recommendations, and social activity. Developers query a single GraphQL endpoint for titles, characters, studios, and authenticated user data. Authentication uses OAuth2 for write and private user operations; many read queries work without a token.

auth.details: OAuth2 authorization code flow for authenticated requests; many public GraphQL queries work without auth. Register an app at anilist.co/settings/developer. Pass access token as Authorization: Bearer {token}.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free to use; no paid plans. Subject to rate limits (90 req/min).

rate_limits: 90 requests per minute (documented). Rate limit headers returned on responses.

example.request: curl -X POST https://graphql.anilist.co -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d '{"query":"query ($id: Int) { Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) { id title { romaji english native } episodes status } }","variables":{"id":15125}}'

use_cases: look up anime or manga by title or ID
fetch a user's anime/manga list and scores
get character, staff, or studio details for a series
update a user's list entry when authenticated
